title: Cross-functional initiative queue: OKR crosswalk and error-budget synchronizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Multiple reliability initiatives (SLO adjustment experiments, infra hardening, KV cache tuning) live across teams and cycles. PMs and eng leads lack a single view that connects initiative priority to active OKRs and real-time error-budget state, which delays decision-making on rollouts, throttles, and rollbacks.

Goal: Build an initiative queue that crosswalks each reliability initiative to OKRs and current error-budget consumption, surfaces auto-thresholded gating recommendations (allow/canary/rollback), and exposes a per-initiative cost-savings estimate if the proposed optimization is deployed. This will enable consistent cadence decisions during quarterly planning and faster operational rollouts when SLI drift occurs.
acceptance_criteria: A consolidated initiative queue UI shows each initiative with linked OKR(s), owner, SLI targets, current error-budget burn rate, and rollout recommendation
Backend API returns initiative objects with fields: okr_ids, slis (with numeric targets), error_budget_state (remaining, burn_rate), estimated_monthly_cost_savings
Automatic gating engine emits a recommended action when error-budget burn crosses thresholds: green (proceed), amber (canary / limited rollout), red (halt/rollback)
Product and Eng owners can annotate initiatives with rollback criteria and link to runbooks in the UI
Integrations: dashboard drilldown links to existing SLI time-series dashboard, and to the specific GitHub PR for the change
tasks: Design: wireframes for initiative queue and gating UI (DES-1402) — include filters for OKR, team, customer impact
Data: standardize initiative data model and map OKR references (schema v2) — ENG work item ENG-4123
Gating: implement threshold evaluator that consumes error-budget stream and emits recommendation events
Console: add row-level actions (annotate, attach runbook link, escalate) and csv export
Analytics: add telemetry to record decisions taken by the gating engine and outcome within 7 days
Docs: Confluence playbook for initiative owners describing how to set SLI targets and rollback criteria
stakeholders: Eng Leads: Marco Li, Elena Garcia
metrics: Time to decision for canary/rollback (target: <= 2 business days)
Percent of initiatives with linked OKR and rollback criteria (target: 90%)
Reduction in emergency rollbacks due to late detection (target: -30% in Q2)
Accuracy of gating recommendations when evaluated vs. manual decision (goal: >= 85% match)
Estimated monthly cost savings surfaced for initiatives (aggregate)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 sprints): backend API + simplified UI for a pilot of 3 initiatives (SRE, Runtime, Console). Phase 2 (1 sprint): gating engine connected to production SLI stream and exportable csv. Phase 3 (incremental): expand to enterprise initiatives and add OKR sync from the OKR service. Pilot owners will run two scheduled decision checkpoints during rollout week and provide feedback in retrospective.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: noisy SLI signals cause false positive gating recommendations — Mitigation: add a smoothing window and require sustained burn for 30m before amber/red
Risk: inaccurate cost-savings estimates — Mitigation: conservative estimator using historical token counts and runtime metrics; label estimates as 'preliminary' until validated
Risk: cross-team adoption friction — Mitigation: include product/eng reps in pilot and provide a readiness checklist and office hours
